what: A 200px diameter accent-color circle (.95) follows the cursor with a delay of 1s power4.out and is normally clipped to clip-path circle(4.2%), so it looks like a small dot. Over a data-cursor target it expands to that value (%) in .765s power4.out, and the inner text (data-cursor-text) resolves from 1.4× and transparent to 1× in 1.234s — buttons 2 (shrinks smaller than the dot and hides), links 7, question rows 12, drag-to-swipe panels 32 (”Drag”), photos 50. On leave or press it returns to a dot in .543s power4.out and the text vanishes at .4×

options.size: Spread radius (%) when the data-cursor value is empty, default 50
options.in · out · text: Open, close, and text durations (s), default .765 · .543 · 1.234
options.data-cursor · data-cursor-text: Target-side attributes — spread radius (%) and floating text
